2026-2027.summary: Without comparable peer venue data this week, we're monitoring national touring performance across our 2026-2027 slate. Hell's Kitchen experienced a significant pullback, with grosses dropping 62% and paid capacity falling from 95% to 51%, suggesting potential demand softness for that title. Conversely, The Outsiders and The Great Gatsby showed strength, with The Outsiders surging 41% in grosses and reaching 97% capacity—indicating robust audience interest in that production.
